import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().start();
    }

    void start() {
        try {
            BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            BufferedWriter bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
            
            String line;
            while (!(line = br.readLine()).trim().isEmpty()) {
                String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
                int n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                if (n == 0) break;
                
                double[][] circles = new double[n][3];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
                    circles[i][0] = Double.parseDouble(parts[0]);
                    circles[i][1] = Double.parseDouble(parts[1]);
                    circles[i][2] = Double.parseDouble(parts[2]);
                }
                
                int regions = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    regions++;
                    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                        double d = distance(circles[i][0], circles[i][1], circles[j][0], circles[j][1]);
                        double r1 = circles[i][2];
                        double r2 = circles[j][2];
                        
                        if (d < r1 + r2 && d > Math.abs(r1 - r2)) {
                            regions++;
                        } else if (d == 0 && r1 == r2) {
                            // Identical circles - no new region
                            regions--;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                bw.write(regions + "\n");
                bw.flush();
            }
            bw.close();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException(e);
        }
    }
    
    double distance(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {
        double dx = x2 - x1;
        double dy = y2 - y1;
        return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    }
}
